comment.cs: Částečně splněno. Jednotné měsíční hlášení zaměstnavatele (JMHZ) je funkční od 1. dubna 2026 v plném rozsahu. Zákon č. 323/2025 Sb. nabyl účinnosti 1. ledna 2026, ale ostrý start systému byl 1. dubna 2026. Systém nahrazuje až 25 různých hlášení jedním elektronickým měsíčním podáním. comment.en: Partially fulfilled. The Unified Monthly Employer Report (JMHZ) has been fully operational since 1 April 2026. Act No. 323/2025 Sb. entered into force on 1 January 2026, but the system's full launch was 1 April 2026. It replaces up to 25 different reports with a single electronic monthly submission. However, this is partial fulfillment because: (1) health insurance companies will join the system later (experts expect 2029), (2) employers had to retroactively submit reports for January–March 2026 by 30 June 2026, meaning the system is not a fully unified collection point from the start.

Vláda Babiše v lednu 2026 jmenovala vládního zmocněnce pro technické vzdělávání a v květnu 2026 vydala metodický materiál k duálnímu praktickému vyučování. comment.en: Dual education was introduced by law no. 267/2025 Sb. (effective from 1 January 2026), which is the work of the previous government. The Babiš government appointed a government commissioner for technical education in January 2026 and issued methodological guidance on dual practical training in May 2026. Individual regions and schools are gradually implementing dual education (e.g., the Zlín region from school year 2026/2027). The government is thus continuing implementation, but the introduction itself is the work of the previous government.

comment.en: An interconnected data ecosystem with open interfaces is part of Digital Czechia 2.0 and the National IT Concept. The government approved a strategic project management system in May 2026. Individual ministries (MPSV, MZ) are preparing information concepts aimed at system unification and integration, but legislative grounding is lacking.

comment.en: The government is implementing the AI Act (EU 2024/1689), which will enter into force in August 2026. In January 2026, it appointed Lukáš Kačena as AI commissioner. An Action Plan for the National AI Strategy with approximately 86 concrete measures is being prepared. Pilot projects (chatbots, request processing) are underway, but legislative implementation of the AI Act is not yet complete.

Neexistuje však doklad o zahájení skutečného auditu státních IT systémů. comment.en: The government declared a goal of auditing state IT and combating vendor lock-in as part of the strategic project management system in May 2026. However, there is no evidence of initiating an actual audit of state IT systems. The vendor lock-in problem has been long-known (SAO, Datlab), but the government has not presented specific legislative or executive measures to address it.
